about: What fails the server-bench gate (ci/box/server_bench.py). Each number of bench/bench.py's result, flattened to <cell>.<key>, takes the FIRST rule whose glob matches; a number no rule matches is report-only. A gated number fails when the head is worse than base * (1 + rel) + abs (worse = higher), or base * (1 - rel) - abs (worse = lower). Accepting a cost is a reviewed change to this file in the pull request that brings it.
method: Margins come from three full runs (bench.py, no --quick) of one commit (d466439) on the bench box, 2026-11-13, load 2-3.5 at start. 'spread' is (max - min) / median across those runs. Timings are gated at +15% only where the spread was 8% or less; exact-ish numbers (bytes, allocation, counts) at a small margin above their spread; everything noisier is report-only.
